transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Understand a time-based before/after claim and immediately see the boundary between observed data and the claimed implications.
transferable_mechanism.argument_shape: Single-series time chart plus explicitly separated outcome callouts.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Lead with a scoped, labelled time series; mark the change boundary directly on it; then distil only the conclusions that the source data, method, and comparison can support.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only with real, traceable data, visible units, dates, scope, method, and limitations. A before/after line alone cannot establish causality.
